# PFTC Teaching Material {.unnumbered}

This book is the teaching material for the Plant Functional Trait Courses (PFTC).
The courses are hands-on training in trait-based ecology.
More about the courses themselves is on the course [webpage](https://plantfunctionaltraitscourses.w.uib.no/).

The book has two parts.

- **The PFTC model** covers the courses and the data life cycle they follow.
- **The PFTC toolbox** is the teaching for each step on the wheel: Create, Process, Share, and Re-use.

Start with [the PFTC model](pftc_model.qmd), or open a step in the toolbox.
